cases.name: composer line still speaks to a child
cases.text: I can't talk right now. Please tell a grown-up.

cases.name: rail LED is short and red when down
rail tooltip is medium and uses the service template
cases.text: Library is paused. Your message stays here.

cases.name: app header is medium and an admin gets the Repairs link
